title: Police complaint against WB LoP, police officers for fabrication of affidavits before ECI
description: The police complaint, was registered at city’s Kalighat Police station by Subhasish Chakraborty on behalf of Trinamool Congress;  in the complaint, the loyalist of Mamata Banerjee has claimed that he has credible proofs that Nanoor police station officials conspired with Ritabrata Banerjee and Arup Roy to prepare false and fabricated affidavits
